title: Foundations: Healthcare Clinical Data Types
summary: What healthcare clinical data types are and why shared schemas matter.
body:
Data types for care delivery: patients, encounters, orders, and results. (De-identified patterns only.)

Shared data types let every system in healthcare clinical exchange records without translation errors. This database defines the core entities — each with fields, types, a real example, and the standard it follows. Use the type-definition records to design, and the schema records to build.
facts: Data types for care delivery: patients, encounters, orders, and results. (De-identified patterns only.)

title: PatientRecord - Type Definition
summary: Field-level definition of PatientRecord for healthcare clinical.
body:
PatientRecord: One patient's demographics (pattern).

FIELDS:
- patient_id (string): MRN hash
- birth_year (number): Year
- sex (string): M/F/X
- language (string): Preferred
- active (boolean): Active?

EXAMPLE:
{
 "patient_id": "PT-9F2A",
 "birth_year": 1978,
 "sex": "F",
 "language": "en",
 "active": true
}

STANDARD: HL7 FHIR Patient (de-identified). Every record of this type should carry these fields with these meanings — that consistency is what makes data interoperable across healthcare clinical systems.
